Diagnostic: the log report now says when the music was never fitted to your real break lengths.

Since 0.6.5 a full regenerate re-lays the music once the commercial log is in, so hours are sized by the spots actually in each break rather than the length you configured. If the commercial log doesn't complete, that second pass is skipped — sizing hours against breaks that were never filled would be worse — but until now it was skipped silently, which looks exactly like the fix not working.

The report now says so, names the reason, and tells you to fix the commercial problem and regenerate.
